title: Agronomist
description:
Seeking an Agronomist to support our farming operations. Key Responsibilities:
- Analyze soil and crop data to optimize yield and quality.
- Develop sustainable farming practices and pest management strategies.
- Advise farmers on seed selection, fertilization, and irrigation techniques.
- Conduct field research and trials.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Agronomy, Agriculture, or related field.
- Strong knowledge of plant science and soil health.
- Problem-solving skills and ability to work outdoors.
- Excellent data analysis and reporting capabilities.
